longDescription: Upload a txt, md or epub manuscript and use your own DeepSeek or Kimi API key to extract characters, merge aliases, group factions and build relationships, producing one interactive, mobile-friendly graph page. Search characters, tap for profiles, filter by faction and pinch to zoom; host it anywhere or share the file. Re-running the same book hits a local cache and costs zero tokens. You get a cost estimate before anything runs, and the API key stays on your machine only.
tryPrompts: Turn this epub into a character relationship graph
Estimate the processing cost first using my own DeepSeek key
Re-render the graph page from the cached data

book-graph.description: Upload a manuscript and generate a publishable character relationship graph page with your own DeepSeek or Kimi key.
